hypothesised_pattern: Target class is class_2 when x4^2 - 0.25 exceeds about 1.85*|x2*x5|, and otherwise positive x2*x5 gives class_1 and negative x2*x5 gives class_0.
functional_form_guess: predict class_2 if x4^2 - 0.25 > 1.85*|x2*x5|, else class_1 if x2*x5 > 0, else class_0
rationale: All ten examples fit the rule. Idx 6 and 9 have sizeable x4^2 of about 1.8 and 2.7 but x2*x5 of about 1.0 and 3.1, so they stay in class 1, while idx 2 and 4 have small products and are class 2. Idx 6 sits fairly close to the boundary, with x4^2 - 0.25 of about 1.58 against 1.85*|x2*x5| of about 1.89.
